hook_en: As far as the east is from the west. 🙏
reflect_en: David reminds us that the LORD is compassionate and gracious, and that He has not dealt with us according to our sins. This Sunday, as you worship, you can lay down what you've been carrying and rest in the truth that He has removed your transgressions as far as the east is from the west.
q_en: What do you need to lay down before God this Sunday?
x_en: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
tiktok: Your past doesn't get the last word 🙏 Psalm 103:8–12 — as far as the east is from the west
yt_title: As Far as the East Is from the West | Psalm 103:8–12 #Shorts
li_open: The best leaders don't keep a ledger of every mistake.
li_quote: The LORD is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion.
li_body: David describes a God who is slow to anger and does not harbor His anger forever. Leaders who extend that same grace, and who pray for their people instead of holding past failures over them, build teams where people feel safe to grow and to ask for help.
hook_es: Tan lejos como el oriente del occidente. 🙏
reflect_es: David nos recuerda que misericordioso y clemente es Jehová, y que no ha hecho con nosotros conforme a nuestras iniquidades. Este domingo, al adorarle, puedes soltar lo que has venido cargando y descansar en que Él hizo alejar de ti tus rebeliones, cuanto está lejos el oriente del occidente.
q_es: ¿Qué necesitas dejar delante de Dios este domingo?
x_es: Cuanto está lejos el oriente del occidente, hizo alejar de nosotros nuestras rebeliones.
